result.query: Use the optical and SAR images together and highlight where the water is.
result.text: Using the optical and SAR images jointly: built-up / man-made surface 2.3% (34.0 ha); water-covered 4.1% (60.5 ha); vegetation 47.5% (699.8 ha). Cross-modal agreement — water kappa 0.03 (optical 4.1%, SAR 17.3%); built-up / man-made surface kappa 0.03 (optical 2.3%, SAR 4.8%); mean kappa 0.03. Optical and SAR disagree about water (kappa 0.03): reported as low-agreement rather than merged. Optical and SAR disagree about built-up / man-made surface (kappa 0.03): reported as low-agreement rather than merged. Largest joint regions: water in the south (32.2 ha); water in the north-west (27.7 ha); built-up / man-made surface in the north (2.7 ha). Caveats: No SWIR band: water uses NDWI (more sensitive to built-up confusion than MNDWI) and built-up uses brightness+texture rather than NDBI. SAR-only input: classes derive from backscatter level and roughness; vegetation vigour and water chemistry are not observable. Localised 1 water region for "Use the optical and SAR images together and highlight where the water is.": south of the scene, box [0.3, 66.9, 99.7, 76.8] in 0-100 image coordinates (32.2 ha). 2 candidate regions of this class were considered before the qualifiers were applied. Caveats: No SWIR band: water uses NDWI (more sensitive to built-up confusion than MNDWI) and built-up uses brightness+texture rather than NDBI.
